title: Hidden Eligibility and the Credibility of Adoption
abstract: arXiv:2609.31744v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Subsidies encourage adoption, but they also change what others can learn from it. We study a government that chooses the amount and coverage of an early-adoption rebate and the information released about eligibility. Both early and late adoption create positive externalities. When eligibility is hidden, expanding the programme makes adoption less informative. As the benefit of early adoption rises, the optimal programme jumps from a small one that preserves imitation to a larger one that gives it up. We show that partial disclosure can support intermediate coverage and strictly improve on both optimally chosen opacity and full disclosure. An optimal report certifies the eligibility of some users, leaving the remaining adoptions sufficiently persuasive to induce imitation. translated_title: 隐藏资格与采纳行为的可信度
translated_abstract: 补贴能够鼓励采纳，但也会改变他人能从中获取的信息。我们研究了一个政府，它选择早期采纳返利的金额与覆盖范围，以及关于资格信息的发布方式。早期采纳和晚期采纳都会产生正外部性。当资格被隐藏时，扩大计划会使采纳行为的信息含量降低。随着早期采纳收益的上升，最优计划会从小型的保留模仿行为的计划，跃迁到一个放弃模仿行为的更大规模的计划。我们证明，部分披露能够支持中等程度的覆盖范围，并严格优于最优选择的完全隐瞒和完全披露。最优的报告会对部分用户的资格进行认证，同时使其余用户的采纳行为仍然足够有说服力，从而引发模仿。我们刻画了这一政策成立的条件，并比较了不同报告规则下的覆盖范围。分析性扩展还考虑了送达失败、私人信息等情形。
tldr: 该论文研究政府如何设计早期采纳补贴及资格信息披露规则，发现部分披露——认证部分用户资格而保留其余采纳的说服力——能严格优于完全隐瞒和完全披露，从而维持模仿激励并提升补贴计划的效果。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that in designing adoption subsidies, partially disclosing eligibility—certifying some users while keeping remaining adoptions persuasive—strictly outperforms both full opacity and full disclosure by preserving imitation incentives.
